title: ResourcePolicyMember
description: Output-only policy member strings of a Google Cloud resource's built-in identity.

iamPolicyNamePrincipal.description: Output only. IAM policy binding member referring to a Google Cloud resource by user-assigned name (https://google.aip.dev/122). If a resource is deleted and recreated with the same name, the binding will be applicable to the new resource. Example: `principal://parametermanager.googleapis.com/projects/12345/name/locations/us-central1-a/parameters/my-parameter`

iamPolicyUidPrincipal.description: Output only. IAM policy binding member referring to a Google Cloud resource by system-assigned unique identifier (https://google.aip.dev/148#uid). If a resource is deleted and recreated with the same name, the binding will not be applicable to the new resource Example: `principal://parametermanager.googleapis.com/projects/12345/uid/locations/us-central1-a/parameters/a918fed5`
